second_attempt_with_segv_guard.root_cause_deeper: tls_shape_valid + tls_launch_valid are file-static __thread variables in may13_intercept_cudart.cpp TU. The OUTER cuBLAS shim (cipher_rt_cublas_shim.c) lives in a DIFFERENT translation unit and CANNOT set may13's file-static TLS. The cipher_rt_phase4 canonical cuBLAS shim path therefore doesn't trigger may13's local TLS markers; the SEGV-guard never fires for cipher_rt_phase4-routed cuBLAS calls.
second_attempt_with_segv_guard.may13_local_cuBLAS_shim: would set these TLS markers but was DROPPED from g_patches[] at .8.1 to avoid conflict with cipher_rt_phase4 canonical shim. The TLS markers thus stay 0 for all cuBLAS-internal launches.

fix_options_for_v1_x: Option A — Per-stream capture-state cache: hook cuStreamBeginCapture + cuStreamEndCapture; maintain shadow set of capturing streams; check the set instead of calling cuStreamGetCaptureInfo per launch. Zero per-launch driver call. ~2-3 ED.

Option B — Cross-TU shared TLS marker: add extern __thread int cipher_in_cublas_inflight to cipher_v2_internal.h; set/reset in cipher_rt_cublas_shim.c around real cuBLAS calls; check from may13 helper. ~0.5 ED. Tight coupling but minimal code.
Option C — Stream-identity discriminator: cache CUstream pointers known to be cuBLAS-internal at first SEGV-or-bypass detection; bail on those streams. Lazy + fragile.
section_v1_x_carry.recommendation: Option A — cleanest, decouples capture detection from per-launch driver introspection, framework-agnostic
